title: Stew with Syrian Bread
description: A hearty stew made with tender beef and served with crispy Syrian bread on the side. This recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 cup of water in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the stew and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
While the stew is cooking, chop the broccoli into florets.
Heat 1 tsp of oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the broccoli and cook until tender.
Slice the Syrian bread into strips.
Serve the stew with the broccoli and Syrian bread on the side.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
